recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7379 unless the work group reopens the broader Composition/document boundary after the later FHIR-14723, FHIR-13426, or FHIR-25438 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7379 was a Published/Persuasive Structured Documents change request asking the Composition introduction to clarify that Composition defines document structure, establishes context, and is not itself the complete document content; the complete document is a Bundle containing the Composition and other resources.
initial_application: The Jira records acceptance with a 2015 svn revision 6205 application note. No FHIR-7379-tagged git commit is present in the current repository history, but current Composition source retains the requested distinction by saying Composition establishes context and provides document structure, while full document content is expressed by a Bundle containing the Composition and entries.
additional_context: FHIR-14723 later became Published/Persuasive and replaced the too-absolute phrase that Composition does not contain content because Composition can contain narrative content. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-14723 reconciliation commit, and later FHIR-13426 and FHIR-25438 commits generalized the same current wording from clinical document-only phrasing to package and author-traceability language. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira and source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Composition source already says Composition groups information into a coherent package that establishes context, that when used as a FHIR document it provides the document structure, that full document content is expressed in a Bundle containing the Composition and entries, and that a Composition alone does not constitute a document.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the absolute no-content wording by stating Composition can include narrative content while not being a complete document by itself; already represented on the combined branch.
Generalized Composition scope/introduction wording while preserving the context and Bundle/document distinction.
Removed clinical-only wording from the Composition definition now used to satisfy this issue.
